The '''B2-X Computer Interface Unit''' was a [[Computer probe/Legends|computer probe]] manufactured by the [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] Corporation.<ref name="Blue Max">{{DB|droid|bluemax|Blue Max}}</ref>

MerrenData was contracted by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] to produce the B2-X for its network security and slice investigation capabilities. As an Imperial model, the unit had a brusque personality and no means of locomotion.<ref name="Blue Max" /> Built in the shape of a cube and deep blue in color, this computer interface unit was capable of processing data that was scanned through a glowing red [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]]<ref name="EGC" /> and interpreted through a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocoder]]. The probe was equipped with a set of [[Scomp link/Legends|computer probes]] for interfacing with a variety of networks. The B2-X processors and software had the capability of slicing through some of the most hardened security systems.<ref name="Blue Max" />

From [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a converted B2-X computer interface unit named [[Blue Max]] traveled with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on their adventures in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].
